verdict.rationale: The axis applies because Vercel ships an Observability product, but the pack never documents a custom dashboard builder or a way to bring in metrics from external services. The closest evidence is emitting custom metrics from Vercel Functions and querying them in Observability or via `vercel metrics`, plus built-in monitoring of traffic, function performance and errors. That is an adjacent capability limited to Vercel's own workloads, not composing dashboards across any service.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can build custom dashboards combining metrics from any service
